title: vector embeddings (2D example)
diagram_summary: A 2D vector embedding example showing how categorical words (king, man, woman, apple, banana, orange, football, golf, tennis) are transformed through an embedding layer into 2D vector coordinates, then plotted on a 2D coordinate system where semantically similar items cluster together.
diagram_elements: Input words: king, man, woman (blue), apple, banana, orange (red), football, golf, tennis (green)
Vector coordinates matrix with 10 rows of 2D vectors
2D coordinate plot with three clusters: green cluster (sports), blue cluster (royalty/people), red cluster (fruits)
